package handlers

import "strings"

// safeStudentReviewRawResult keeps trusted diagnostics in storage while
// exposing only attempt-level assessment feedback to student endpoints.
func safeStudentReviewRawResult(rawResult map[string]any, passed bool) map[string]any {
	if rawResult == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if !isTaskTestRawResult(rawResult) {
		return rawResult
	}

	result := map[string]any{"source": "task_test"}
	if mode, ok := rawResult["mode"].(string); ok && strings.TrimSpace(mode) != "" {
		result["mode"] = mode
	}
	if total, exists := rawResult["total_questions"]; exists {
		result["total_questions"] = total
	}
	if passed {
		result["errors"] = []any{}
		return result
	}
	result["errors"] = []any{map[string]any{
		"code":    "ASSESSMENT_INCORRECT",
		"message": "Assessment answer is incorrect",
	}}
	return result
}

func isTaskTestRawResult(rawResult map[string]any) bool {
	if rawResult == nil {
		return false
	}
	source, _ := rawResult["source"].(string)
	return strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(source), "task_test")
}
